task_evaluations.name: OpenTelemetry Tracing
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to instrument pipelines with OpenTelemetry
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I add distributed tracing to my data pipeline using OpenTelemetry?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain how to instrument data pipelines with OpenTelemetry for tracing, including span creation and context propagation.

task_evaluations.name: Prometheus Metrics
task_evaluations.prompt: What metrics should I collect for my data pipeline and how do I expose them to Prometheus?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should recommend key data pipeline metrics and explain how to instrument and expose them for Prometheus scraping.

task_evaluations.name: Pipeline Alerting
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to set up alerts for pipeline failures
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I set up alerts for data pipeline failures and anomalies?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain alerting strategies, threshold configuration, and notification routing for data pipeline issues.
